svg.desc: Firing rate is the fraction of responses with p at least 0.5. Dots are observed rates in margin bins; curves are fitted firing rates. Base laya fires for every sampled state and has no fitted curve. Jev and fine-tuned laya are compared on the same 600 distinct states per panel.
